min_length.description: Minimum password length in characters. Must be ≥ 4 and ≤ 128.

max_length.description: Maximum password length in characters. Set to 0 for no limit.

min_digits.description: Minimum number of digit characters (0–9) required.

min_lower.description: Minimum number of lowercase letters (a–z) required.

min_upper.description: Minimum number of uppercase letters (A–Z) required.

min_other.description: Minimum number of special (non-alphanumeric) characters required.

max_consecutive.description: Maximum number of identical consecutive characters allowed.

min_classes.description: Minimum number of character classes (upper, lower, digit, special) required.

min_days.description: Minimum number of days a user must keep a password before changing it.

max_days.description: Maximum number of days a password is valid before expiration.

warn_days.description: Number of days before password expiration to warn the user.

inactive_days.description: Number of days after expiration during which the account remains active, then disabled.

old_passwords.description: Number of previous passwords to remember (history depth).

dictionary_check.description: If true, all passwords are checked against a system dictionary (e.g., /usr/share/dict/words).

strict_non_root.description: If true, non-root users are strictly subject to all password policies.

disallow_words.description: List of additional words (e.g., username, domain, common terms) to disallow in passwords.

pam_enforce.description: If true, password policies are enforced via PAM (Pluggable Authentication Modules).
